messages:
eli: FYI we're seeing GPU node join failures in usw2 since ~03:12 UTC. Keystore decrypts are failing with STS token errors, likely tied to yesterday's ephemeral-role tweak.

samir: on it. can you drop the exact error snippet?

eli: logs:
```
2025-07-12T03:13:08Z node-1234 ERROR keystore.decrypt failed status=AccessDenied detail=STS:InvalidIdentityToken grant_id=ephemeral-20250712-02:45
2025-07-12T03:13:11Z node-1235 WARN join retry=3 reason=keystore.decrypt
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: ephemeral-iam-rollout v2.3.1 applied region=usw2 at 02:45 UTC (author=taylor).

maria: if the rollout tightened kms:Decrypt to require encryptionContext, that would break older ephemeral grants missing the context.

samir: IAM traces show assume-role tokens lacking encryptionContext -> STS InvalidIdentityToken. Retries are spiking audit-sampler QPS and egress.

taylor: cost impact: retries are causing extra audit egress and S3 snapshots. small billing blip visible. Rollback vs exception?

eli: short-term plan: 1) create time-limited IAM exception to permit current ephemeral grants to decrypt for 1h 2) reduce node-join audit sampling to 10% for 30m to limit egress 3) follow-up to add encryptionContext to grant issuance.

maria: +1 for exception. Need documented window and an owner. Also request canary requirement for future IAM rollouts (staging-only for 1h).

samir: I'll create a temp policy and attach to the onboarding role with expire=04:30 UTC. Will stage then prod after quick approval. Adding audit annotations.

ops-bot: iam-bot: temp-policy onboarding-ephemeral-exception created (expires=2025-07-12T04:30:00Z). staged; prod apply pending @maria approval.

taylor: I'll throttle sampler immediately to 10% for node-join events for 30m to curb egress.

eli: also add alert: keystore.decrypt.failures > 5/min -> pager to eng-oncall.

samir: prod change applied at 03:20 UTC after @maria ok via DM. Nodes rejoining, warm-pool recovering. Failed joins dropped from ~120/min to <2/min in 5m.

maria: follow-ups: - INFRA-2481 to add encryptionContext to ephemeral grants (owner=samir) - require IAM rollout canary gating - postmortem if failures > 50 in 24h

taylor: quick cost tally for the blip: audit egress + retries ~ $1.2k, keystore ops ~ $0.8k. Logging into finance ticket.

eli: closing this thread for now. monitoring continues. :thumbsup: 

samir: created INFRA-2481 and assigned to self. will update. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: sampler auto-rollback executed at 03:50 UTC (sampler restored).

eli: if this repeats we escalate to eng-security for expedited rollback path.
